The '''Salvager camp''' was the headquarters of a loose association of [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] came to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in order to explore the what was left of the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] after [[Darth Malak]] [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|bombed]] it. These people recovered most of what was in the structure and sold them to make a profit, excluding the sublevel due to the presence of [[laigrek]]s.

The salvagers here generally held beings with regular jobs in contempt, and would have been particularly pleased if the settlers had been driven off the planet.
